versions.changelog: v2.1.0: 新增抖音/今日头条 + 脚本重写

hot-topics-daily v1.1.0

- Added flexible config.json for platform/channel/settings customization.
- Platforms can now be enabled or disabled individually.
- Support customizing items shown per platform and title length.
- Improved installation guide and added troubleshooting section.
- Simplified configuration process for easier setup.

hot-topics-daily v1.0.0

- 首次发布每日热搜速览推送技能
- 支持自动抓取微博、知乎、百度、B站等平台热搜
- 提供定时（Cron）及手动推送到指定 Discord 子区
- 推送信息包含各平台热搜 TOP 5
- 提供灵活平台选择及推送目标配置
